title: Requirement
description: We define goals, budget, constraints, and expected usage so the architecture is chosen correctly.

title: Design
description: We build schematic and PCB layout with care for signal integrity and power delivery.

title: Review
description: We check manufacturing issues, routing cleanliness, and improvement opportunities.

title: Delivery
